cliff_findings.summary: The ann/DD Pareto frontier is concave and steep. Best achievable on 5K budget across 8 rounds and 90+ explorations: ann ~62-65% with DD ~18-28%. Reaching ann 90% requires multiplier stacks that push DD to 30-45%. Reaching DD <= 10% requires multipliers so low that ann drops below 30%.
structural_drivers: 2025 choppy bear segment: martingale cycles stop at ~50% rate (single direction adverse moves of -34% to -73% on AAVE/SOL/DOT). Every strategy has 2025 negative.
Funding cost drag: 8-17% of budget consumed by funding on aggressive sleeves. Cost-gate exploration did not unlock further DD reduction.
Budget constraint: 5K across 6-7 symbols means each sleeve has ~700U. With exchange min-notional 5U and martingale multiplier 1.5-3.5x, max legs and first-order sizing are tightly bounded.
DD-stop equity base: budget-based DD stop fires correctly but cannot prevent the initial 15-25% drawdown before throttling engages.

what_worked: Partial TP + breakeven stop (R2): flipped h2_2023 positive, reduced DD from 26% to 19%.
Conditional safety orders with last-executed basis (R5): reduced wasted margin on dead cycles.
Quarantine after stop clusters (R6-R7): improved BOTH ann and DD on ANKR sleeve.
Lagged dynamic allocator (R8 P2): rotated among sleeves using prior-window rolling_return - 2*DD score, achieving DD<=20 with ann>50 for the first time.
what_did_not_work: Trailing lock (R6): breakeven floor too aggressive, killed profitable cycles before TP.
DD state machine throttling (R6-R7): improved DD marginally but reduced ann more.
Funding cost gate (R7): funding rates were not large enough to be the dominant DD driver.
DCA grid reset (R8 P3): 148 candidates, no target hit.
Cost-cover rescue exit (R8 P4): 96 candidates, no target hit.
Loss streak risk reduction (R5): triggered too late to matter.
Vol-targeted first-order scaling (R5): flattened returns without improving DD.
open_engine_gaps_for_live_parity: R8 P2 allocator: implemented in scripts/glm_r8_regime_rescue_allocator.py (Python, backtest-side). NOT implemented in apps/trading-engine. To deploy live requires portfolio-level scheduler that tracks per-sleeve equity, computes 60d rolling return+DD, rotates active sleeve every 7d.
R6 DD state machine: engine logic implemented in backtest-engine, partially in trading-engine.
R7 quarantine: engine logic implemented in both backtest-engine and trading-engine.
R4-combo is the ONLY fully live-ready sleeve today (full parity in trading-engine).

recommendation_for_next_round.primary: Implement R8 P2 allocator logic in trading-engine (portfolio-level scheduler). This is the single highest-leverage gap - it converts the best DD<=20 / ann>50 result into a deployable strategy.
recommendation_for_next_round.secondary: Explore capital scaling: at 10K-20K budget, the budget constraint loosens, allowing more legs and finer first-order sizing. May unlock ann 80%+ at DD<=20.
recommendation_for_next_round.tertiary: Add 2025-specific regime filter: a regime classifier that detects choppy bear and switches to defensive sleeve (R4-combo) BEFORE the DD materializes. This is the only path to DD<=10.
